name: Momentum Top-10 Expanded Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Selects the top 10 assets by 12-month trailing return from the full 30-asset expanded universe (equities, EM/Europe equity flavours, precious metals, energy, broad commodities, and a 5-asset bond sleeve), weights by inverse volatility, then scales to 15% annualised volatility. A wider-breadth companion to the concentrated Top-3 full-universe strategy, sized for the larger post-expansion asset count.
